g.text: 1. [P2] Is multi-factor authentication (MFA) enabled for email, VPN and admin accounts?
2. [R2] Is at least one backup kept offline or immutable?
3. [S1] Is there a written incident response plan that covers ransomware?
Score bands are this tool's own, not an official standard or certification.
